items.text: $DIS Segment eliminations were 565 million dollars in fiscal Q3 in the 10-Q, up from 448 million a year earlier, and 1,751 million for the nine months against 1,379 million. The filing ties the increase to the Fubo and NFL deals, with the video services now paying the linear networks and ESPN fees that get eliminated in consolidation.

items.author: topstockalerts
items.text: Disney is expanding its use of AI across animation, streaming, finance and theme parks under CEO Josh D’Amaro. In December, it will launch Ozzy Fox, an AI-assisted animated series on Disney+, developed with French startup Animaj. The company is also testing AI-powered recommendations, automated financial reporting, conversational characters for theme parks and tools to accelerate film production.
items.label: neutral

items.text: $DIS ESPN ownership got redrawn in the 10-Q. On Jan 31 ESPN took in NFL Network, the RedZone pay TV distribution and NFL Fantasy from the NFL, and the NFL got a 10 percent stake in ESPN back. Disney holds 72 percent now, Hearst holds 18 percent. The deal was valued at about 3 billion dollars, and a significant portion of that value was deferred in other assets.
